1936, November
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO, 6.
Page 154 Cont.
Nov. 28 Mrs. Cath. Kelly - 74 - broke leg a month ago ... phone call asks prayers ... "dying" Itch - Clarkson
1936, December
December
Dec. 5 John Radimaker - 16 - Mother non Catholic insistant on sending boy to public school. Boy politely but quite decidedly insisted on Catholic high-school. Mother was enrolled in Ser. M -- and prayed for .... Mother changed her resolution - even came to Monastery. Deo Gratias!
6 Gertrude DeJardens - 44 - skin-cancer - all over body - now coming in throat - can hardly speak or sit up.
7 John Nernberg - 70 - threatened with cancerous groth
Page 155
Dec. 7 Annie Cowen - 43 - accident Nov. 6 nearly killed, only support of mother and invalid sister - restoration to health and favorable set- tlement.
8(7) Miss Angela Sweeney - 45 - suporting mother ....... swindled - racke- teered out of about $3000.00 % Ex Senator (Wood) without any consent of hers in regard to ...... served with a judgement of $7000.00
"(7) Wm. Joseph Paquette - 52 - Maningitis - given up as hopeless three weeks ago - prayed for last week. Now seemingly rapidly improving - knows his father and friends ..... . Herman Kiefer Hosp.
M. Fellrath - 2 - swallowed big brass pin Monday - X-ray showed threatening position of pin .. phoned to inscribe in S.M.A. - Drs. say: "Myracle!" Here To-day OK.
Maueen Bogard of Rockwood, Mich. - 10 mo. - blind in left eye since birth - otherwise a bright little live wire. She was enrolled in Ser. M. Ass'n last August and since that the eye has ceased running. Non Cath. Father proposes to start instructions in thanksgiving and in hopes of further results. Specialists have been advising removal of said eye. Please. ...
Jennie LaTulip - 69 - cataracts and goiter
